event_name: Document 43 Date 01 July 2018 Time 16:15 2018 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 28 June - 01 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 55 left the track and rejoined at exit of turn 1, then deliberately crowded car 31.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 as defined by the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, and breach of Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: A penalty of a Reprimand is imposed. This is the driver's first Reprimand of the current season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence including on-board cameras of the 2 cars concerned and the following cars, and concluded that the driver of car 55 had left the track, lost momentum, rejoined in front of car 31, then as car 31 drew level, car 55 moved unnecessily to the right hand side of the track deliberately crowding car 31 partially off the track. All
title: Doc 43 2018 Austrian Grand Prix Offence Car 55 Crowding Car 31
